title: Ablaze in Flames
lead: “Possibly I can ignite other people’s fires with my work.” A poetic tribute to the passions that move us.
text: Though creative practices differ, art, music, writing and dance can be driven by a shared inner fire. Featuring Lena Whooo and Nicholas Isaiah King Rose, the short documentary celebrates the energy that makes artists create and keep pursuing their dreams.
The concept began with one question, asked in German and French: Wofür brennst du? Pour quoi brûles-tu? What are you burning for?
The notebook collects the fire as image and as feeling: light, movement and the faces of people who keep creating.
